verdict.rationale: Publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a DevOps platform like GitLab, so the axis applies. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path; every one returned 404. The llms.txt file is documentation for LLMs, not an API spec, and the CLI and MCP mentions are adjacent features, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
